Plan a safe Marswalk in 3 steps

  1. Pick where to go — a science stop on real NASA HiRISE terrain of Mount Sharp.
  2. Pick a route — the planner compares a safe, a balanced and a science route.
  3. Go on EVA — walk the astronaut (W/A/S/D) or use autopilot, then try an emergency.

Everything runs inside this browser — no network link to Earth needed.
